meta.name: The Dead Lands 1080p
meta.description: Waka, a murdered Māori warrior returned from the Afterlife, and Mehe, a determined young woman, embark on a quest to find who "broke the world" and how to close the breach between the living and the dead.

videos.title: Tell the Dead I'm Coming
videos.overview: Waka is sent back from the Afterlife to find honour and redemption.

videos.title: The Sins of the Fathers
videos.overview: Waka and Mehe travel to her Uncle's land, where Mehe discovers her uncle's terrible secret.

videos.title: The Kingdom at the Edge of the World
videos.overview: Waka and Mehe go in search of the boy who knows who broke the world.

videos.title: The Exorcism of the Boy
videos.overview: Mehe and Waka bring the boy to the Witches who exorcise him of the evil spirit and discover the name of the one who broke the world.

videos.title: Generational Warfare
videos.overview: Mehe and Waka return to her tribe in the caves to tell them what they've discovered, only to find the Dead have found a way into the hidden cave complex.

videos.title: A Question of Identity
videos.overview: Mehe and Waka search for Waka's father, Te Kaipo, a powerful Shaman responsible for breaking the world.

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Waka helps the Shaman by entering a battle with 3 dead warriors as Mehe delves deeper into the occult secrets.

videos.title: The Sacrifice of Innocence
videos.overview: The hubris of The Great Shaman Te Kaipō's occult experiments become apparent. Season Finale.
